listRecheck.notes: Re-read Oct 22, 2026. Eleven measures B, E, H, O, P, Q, U, V, X, Y, Z with the same jurisdictions as our records. Link texts give only letter and jurisdiction, e.g. 'Measure B - Winters Joint USD', 'Measure E - Solano County'. Every measure document (resolutions, full texts, impartial analyses, arguments, Notice of Measures, Corrected Notice of Measures - Benicia) is hosted on content.solanocounty.gov, which refused the fetch tool (robots_disallowed).

ballotQuestion.text: To improve the quality of education; repair or replace leaky roofs; modernize/renovate outdated classrooms, restrooms and school facilities; and replace deteriorating plumbing and sewer systems; shall Winters Joint Unified School District’s measure authorizing $29,900,000 in bonds, at legal interest rates, and levying approximately $49 per $100,000 of assessed valuation (raising $1,600,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding, be adopted, with a Board-appointed citizens’ oversight committee and annual independent audits to assure proper expenditure of funds?
ballotQuestion.notes: Reader returned the question in seven segments, joined here with single spaces. Amount and levy figures matched on a second reading.

measureType.evidence: shall Winters Joint Unified School District’s measure authorizing $29,900,000 in bonds, at legal interest rates,

threshold.evidence: This measure requires approval by 55% of the voters voting on it.
threshold.notes: Second reading returned 'To pass, it is required that 55% of the votes cast by Winters Joint Unified School District voters must approve the bond measure.' Both state 55%.

fiscal.text: authorizing $29,900,000 in bonds ... levying approximately $49 per $100,000 of assessed valuation (raising $1,600,000 annually) while bonds are outstanding. Tax rate statement: 'The final fiscal year in which the tax is anticipated to be collected is 2061-62.' '...total debt service, including the principal and interest, that would be required to be repaid if all the bonds are issued and sold is $58,600,000.'

argumentsFiled.notes: Yolo page: 'No arguments were filed AGAINST Measure B by the 5:00 p.m. July 24, 2026 deadline.' Solano list also links only an Argument in Favor.

measures.plainEnglish: Lets Winters Joint Unified School District issue $29,900,000 in bonds to repair or replace leaky roofs, modernize classrooms, restrooms and school facilities, and replace plumbing and sewer systems. The ballot question estimates a levy of about $49 per $100,000 of assessed value, raising $1,600,000 a year while bonds are outstanding.
